scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Can you tell me what my interest rate and the total costs of this loan are?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.990%. The total costs of the loan are $7,221.78.

dialogue.user: I see. Are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: No, this loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Got it. What is my debt-to-income ratio and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. Your loan product is an FHA:First Lien.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now.

<Neutral>
I appreciate your help in clarifying the details of my loan application. The information provided was clear and helpful, but I wish I had more context about my debt-to-income ratio and the reasons behind the interest rate offered. Overall, the interaction was satisfactory.
